2. Sample Data for Initial Load.

ENTITY_ID = 'PA4080765' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '001' will be updated on the next run
ENTITY_ID = 'PA1021988' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '001' will be deleted from the source on the next run
ENTITY_ID = 'PA1022103' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '001' will have no change in details, only filename date will be changed
ENTITY_ID = 'TEST_INSERT' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '001' will be inserted as new record in the source on the next run(not yet inserted on the target table)


SELECT FILE_NAME,SCD_Start_Date,SCD_End_Date,ENTITY_ID,INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,* FROM
EDS.DEP_ITCEP WHERE ENTITY_ID = 'PA4080765' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '001'
UNION ALL

EDS.DEP_ITCEP WHERE ENTITY_ID = 'PA1022103' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '001'
UNION ALL

EDS.DEP_ITCEP WHERE ENTITY_ID = 'TEST_INSERT' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '001'


3. Run scripts to fabricate updated, deleted , new record and update filename date

UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_ITCEP] SET ACCT_CR_PREF_RATE_CODE = 'TEST'
WHERE ENTITY_ID = 'PA4080765' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '001' AND H = 'D';

DELETE FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_ITCEP]
WHERE ENTITY_ID = 'PA1021988' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '001' AND H = 'D';

UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_ITCEP] SET FILE_NAME=REPLACE(FILE_NAME,'20180423','20180426');

INSERT INTO [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_ITCEP]
(H,ENTITY_ID,INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,ENTITY_TYPE,BANK_ID,START_DATE,END_DATE,ACCT_CR_PREF_RATE_CODE,ACCT_DR_PREF_RATE_CODE,ACCT_CR_PREF_PCNT,ACCT_DR_PREF_PCNT,CUST_CR_PREF_PCNT,CUST_DR_PREF_PCNT,CHNL_CR_PREF_PCNT,CHNL_DR_PREF_PCNT,PKG_CR_PREF_PCNT,PKG_DR_PREF_PCNT,ANA_CR_PREF_PCNT,ANA_DR_PREF_PCNT,DEL_FLG,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,TS_CNT,FILE_NAME,insert_dttm)
SELECT 'D','TEST_INSERT' ENTITY_ID,'001'  INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,ENTITY_TYPE,BANK_ID,START_DATE,END_DATE,ACCT_CR_PREF_RATE_CODE,ACCT_DR_PREF_RATE_CODE,ACCT_CR_PREF_PCNT,ACCT_DR_PREF_PCNT,CUST_CR_PREF_PCNT,CUST_DR_PREF_PCNT,CHNL_CR_PREF_PCNT,CHNL_DR_PREF_PCNT,PKG_CR_PREF_PCNT,PKG_DR_PREF_PCNT,ANA_CR_PREF_PCNT,ANA_DR_PREF_PCNT,DEL_FLG,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,TS_CNT,FILE_NAME,insert_dttm FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_ITCEP]  
WHERE ENTITY_ID = 'PA1022103' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '001' AND H = 'D';


SELECT FILE_NAME,ENTITY_ID,INT_PREF_SRL_NUM,* FROM
d360.STG_EDS_DEP_ITCEP WHERE ENTITY_ID = 'PA4080765' AND INT_PREF_SRL_NUM = '001'
UNION ALL

UNION ALL
